metadata.title: On the isoperimetric profile in infinite dimensional pro-Lie groups
metadata.abstract: Let $K$ be a nontrivial compact connected Lie group with a bi-invariant Riemannian metric. On the compact pro-Lie group $K^{\N}$ we define a weighted variation by summing the distributional variations in its Lie group coordinates. We prove that all sublevel sets with bounded $L^1$-norm and weighted variation are compact in $L^1$ if and only if the coordinate weights tend to infinity. The proof gives a quantitative estimate for approximation by Haar averages over normal subgroups, illustrating that it is possible to apply a methodology which is typical of the geometric measure theory in a specific area of the topological group theory. The resulting perimeter is invariant under left and right translations and is preserved under pullback by quotient homomorphisms equipped with quotient metrics. Isoperimetric minimizers exist at every prescribed Haar probability. For the infinite torus, the compactness condition is equivalent to properness of a weighted length on its character group and to compactness of a Fourier multiplier's resolvent. Finally, we show that locally compact noncompact groups require an additional condition of tightness, in order to be treated as an appropriate generalization of the compact case.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 在紧连通 Lie 群的可数积上定义加权变差，证明有界 L¹ 范数和变差的集合紧当且仅当坐标权趋于无穷，并由此建立指定 Haar 体积的等周极小子存在性。
analysis.breakthrough: 把 BV 紧性与等周存在性推进到特定无限维 pro-Lie 群。
analysis.limitations: 依赖积群和权重；非紧局部紧群另需紧性条件，不能直接套用紧群结论。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 几何测度论方法在无限维群上的有用延伸。
